passage:
Nina took the wrong bus on her first day at a new school. She did not notice until the bus turned away from the road she knew.
She wanted to cry, but she remembered her mother's words: "When you are lost, ask clearly."
Nina walked to the driver and explained the problem. The driver told her not to worry. He called the bus office and helped her get off at a safe stop. Another bus came ten minutes later.
Nina arrived at school late, but her teacher did not scold her. Instead, she asked Nina to tell the class what she had learned.
Nina said, "Being lost is scary, but staying quiet makes it worse."
